description: This Java source file defines the ContactsPage class used for automated testing of the contacts management web page, including methods for navigation, contact manipulation, and page interactions using Selenium WebDriver.

classes.name: ContactsPage
classes.description: Represents the contacts management page with methods for interaction and verification.

classes.name: ContactsPage.DeleteContactLink
classes.description: Represents a link to delete a contact, providing a method to perform deletion.

classes.name: ContactsPage.DeleteConfirmationPage
classes.description: Represents the confirmation page after deleting a contact, with method to confirm deletion.

methods.name: accessManagePageWithUnauthenticatedUser
methods.description: Navigates to the manage page as an unauthenticated user and returns a LoginPage object.

methods.name: isAtContactsPage
methods.description: Verifies that the current page is the contacts page.

methods.name: addContact
methods.description: Clicks the 'Add' link to initiate adding a new contact and returns an AddForm.

methods.name: byEmail
methods.description: Returns a predicate to find contact rows by email.

methods.name: byName
methods.description: Returns a predicate to find contact rows by name.

methods.name: andHasContact
methods.description: Finds a contact by name and email, returning a DeleteContactLink.

methods.name: andContactHasBeenRemoved
methods.description: Asserts that a contact with specified name and email has been removed.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out from the contacts page and returns to the HomePage.
